authorization: 2026-10-15 user requested addition of the from-scratch experiment code; no formal training launched
phase: New smaller symbolic development world; equation-(6) GPT adaptation, not original TTCD or Wang reproduction

training.selection: Fixed final step only; retain failures. No edited two-hop labels/readouts select training settings or checkpoint. Budgets and learning rates are unvalidated development starting values.

reading_gate.selection: Held-out correction facts, long-window atomic answer accuracy only. Gate failure is preserved; no automatic retraining.

writer.variant: TTCD equation (6) in GPT GELU; local shared QKV/residual, first round only, all physical MLP down matrices. Per-example fast states in outer training. No original v9 conv/projection/normalization.

runtime.execution: Independent explicit lm-memory Docker context; frozen source and pinned image; no default Docker fallback

scope: Random initialization, compact symbolic vocabulary; no old 300k checkpoint, tokenizer download or pretrained teacher
All old atomic facts may be learned, including role-OOD facts. Only II ordinary composition support is trained
Warmup trains old atomic/II answers plus long-window corrected atomic reading; adaptation adds differentiable TTCD writing and independent atomic read/retention
No corrected two-hop labels or corrected composite queries during either training stage
Correction training facts exclude calibration and evaluation edited target facts; all D queries are outside ordinary composition training support
Each training batch item has independent fast matrices, reset every episode; all repeated physical-layer executions share its matrix
At test time backbone frozen, write only second-hop atomic correction, then clear text/KV and retain only fast matrices
Both models share initialization tensors and data stream, with independently random physical layers; compare exposure and report different compute
Independent training reload audit precedes reading calibration and closed-context edit evaluation
One development world and one initialization; no universal mechanism or efficiency claim
